name: territorio
title: Territorio
author: Lecheric
description: Tile-locked expansion challenge. The map generates normally, but you are confined to a small starting area and must spend Tokens earned through the research tree to purchase adjacent chunks (32x32 tiles), turning the factory into a hyper-dense, space-constrained logistics puzzle. The base game is fully supported. The mod was tuned and balanced against Space Age on Nauvis. The other planets are not tested. Requires Factorio 2.1.
